name: Zombie Shambler (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

items.name: Slow
items.text: A zombie has only 2 actions on its turn, and it can't use reactions.

items.name: Grab
items.text: When the zombie succeeds at its fist Strike, it can use this action immediately after to attempt to grapple the target. This Grapple doesn't apply or count toward the zombie's multiple attack penalty.

text: A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed. Among the living dead, zombies are most often used as fodder, wearing down defenses before more powerful undead arrive to deal the killing blow. Zombies can't truly think for themselves, but they can be commanded by other allied undead and powerful necromancers.
